forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M546E0GAVRF9KFW53JZQRNYT
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: 'T1 follow-up 5/6: AwaitedEvent and AsyncSemaphore waits in tests also end on a task end'
+---
+Source: task ^dbr1dqy (T1 audit, done). The audit comment "kinds of waits checked and left" names this helper change as not made: AsyncSemaphore/AwaitedEvent waits that end on a task end. Reason given: at those sites a task-end watcher would add a race or a spare permit.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (run settle, session close, stream end), or the test must fail before it waits. A fixture closes also when the test body throws.
+Exception rule: first use an event that already exists (the session closes, the run settles, the feed ends). A hook only in test helpers is permitted. Do not change production code only for a test hook. When a case needs such a change, bring it to the coordinating session (swissarmyhammer-96) before you change it. Do not use `.timeLimit`, sleep, poll or retry. Run the full suite one time.
+Work rules: do the work in one agent. Do not run parallel agents on the tree. Edit files only with the edit tool. Do not run swift format.
+
+Helpers (checked against the code on 2026-10-17):
+- `AwaitedEvent.wait()` in Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/AwaitedEvent.swift:83 (test helper). It throws `EventNeverArrived` on a cancel, so `RecordedWaitResult.wait(for:endingOnEndOf:)` (Helpers/RecordedWaitResult.swift:105) can wrap it. Precondition of the type: one waiter at a time. The wrapped form keeps one waiter.
+- `AsyncSemaphore.wait()` in Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Concurrency/AsyncSemaphore.swift:147 is production code. A cancel does not end it (the waiter keeps its FIFO place). A wrapped wait that the test abandons then takes a permit later: this is the "spare permit" of the audit. The production type already has `package func waitUnlessCancelled()` (line 177): a cancelled waiter leaves the queue and takes no permit. Tests can use it (CompactionSignalTests, SessionDrainTests, AnswerCancellationCompactionTests, ScriptedMarkerTools already do). Do not add a new production member.
+
+Failure event to use: the end of the answer or work task that must send the event (it already exists).
+
+Plan:
+- [ ] Add one test helper that waits for an AwaitedEvent or for an AsyncSemaphore permit (through `waitUnlessCancelled()`) and also ends on the end of a task. Choose the name yourself; put it next to RecordedWaitResult.
+- [ ] Audit the AwaitedEvent waits in: AnswerCancellationCompactionTests, AnswerCancellationEntryPointTests, AnswerCancellationFixtures, CancellableWaitTests, ElicitationRoutingTests, GenerationStallDiagnosticTests, Helpers/HeldSessionBackend, Helpers/RepeatingReasoningModel, Helpers/ScriptedMarkerTools, HumanWaitGateTests, RoutedSessionToolContextBindingTests, SessionCloseFromOwnWorkTests, SessionDrainTests, SessionLanguageModelPassWatchTests (AwaitedEventTests tests the type itself; leave it). Change each wait where a failure event exists and the wrap adds no race.
+- [ ] Audit the AsyncSemaphore waits in the test target that a test uses as an event (a "started" or "entered" signal, not a gate that a body holds). Files that make an AsyncSemaphore: BackgroundRunTranscriptTests, PoolEntryQueueTests, GenerationQueueTests, CompactionSignalTests, Helpers/QueueDepthProbe, HumanWaitGateTests, AnswerCancellationCompactionTests, AnswerCancellationFixtures, ExtrasPoolResolveTests, SessionDrainTests, AnswerCancellationEntryPointTests, GenerationQueueSubmissionTests, ToolDisplayDeliveryTests, AwaitAnswerTests, PromptCacheBudgetTests, SessionMailQueueTests, PooledResidencyTests, MultiMessageSessionTests, ResolveCancellationTests, AnswerCancellationTests, Helpers/ScriptedMarkerTools, QueuedPassStallWatchTests, ForkConcurrencyTests, GenerationStallDiagnosticTests (AsyncSemaphoreTests tests the type itself; leave it). Change a wait only when `waitUnlessCancelled()` plus the task end adds no race and no spare permit.
+- [ ] For each site that you leave, write the site and the reason (race, spare permit, or no failure event) in a comment on this card. If a site needs a production change, bring it to swissarmyhammer-96 first.
+- [ ] Run the full suite one time (`swift test`). Record the counts in a comment. #t1-followup
\ No newline at end of file
